This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，古代 already names a time period, so adding 的时候 is redundant.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看：看到，看 means “look,” while 看到 means “see”; here 神农 notices the people eating plants.
3. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃：神农想帮别人，所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃，the connector 所以 expresses a cause-and-effect relation and should link the cause and result smoothly; the subject can stay omitted because it is still 神农.

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines a time period with “的时候”; “在古代” is correct.
Here 神农 notices something, so “看到” correctly replaces “一看” at this point.
The actual error is “帮别人,” which should be “帮他们”; the proposed revision leaves that error unchanged.
